Notes: THE FALLBACK ROW, and the whole point of this file. Pickups used to arrive on a TIMER with a random gap, so a run gave you somewhere between one and six of them and nobody could say which. Now the number is written down: three on the way to each wave, five on the way to the boss, spaced evenly over whatever distance that turns out to be. Leave Drops blank and a pickup gives what the biome's own Drops table gives.
More than the fallback, because the Marshlands is where you learn - and the drop table is named outright so this biome can be generous without changing anybody else's.
